name: Revelations
overview: The book of Revelation reveals the sovereign plan of God through Jesus Christ, who discloses future events to His servants, emphasizing His eternal nature and divine authority. It portrays vivid imagery of heavenly worship and the unfolding of God's judgment, including the opening of seals and the rise of symbolic beasts representing opposition to God. Ultimately, Revelation promises the renewal of creation with a new heaven and new earth, while warning of the final judgment upon the unrepentant, highlighting the eternal consequences of faith and unbelief.
